stemMd: In a language where integer variables store values, p=6; q=p; p=p+1 is executed. What is q afterwards?
explanationMd: At q=p, the value 6 is copied into q. Incrementing p later changes only p. The explicit value-storage rule excludes reference-alias interpretations.

distractorRationale.b: This is the increment, not q's value.
distractorRationale.d: q receives a copy of the earlier value, not a live link.
distractorRationale.e: No sum is assigned to q.
